findings.source: Strings.sol:28 while (true) { ptr--; mstore8(ptr, byte(mod(value, 10), HEX_DIGITS)); value /= 10; if (value == 0) break; }
findings.issue: Same as c00032: Strings.toString's do-while is rotated (first digit written before the loop, the loop tests t / 10 and writes the digit of t / 10), one iteration off from the source.
findings.rule: Recognise a do-while (body; if c: goto body) as one loop with the test at its end instead of peeling one iteration.

notes: Turing example contract; all 16 functions compared line by line. registerBobaBubble builds the require message 'Invalid request:' + toString(...) before testing (as solc does) and copies it through P7 loops; the stor3/stor4 writes and the event are right. Source loop: Strings.toString's while(true) only (rotated). Implicit: string copies (235, 262, 337, 352). Calls to the immutable Turing helper target 0x0 (artifact).
summary: Small, complete and faithful; only Strings.toString's do-while is rotated by one iteration and the string concatenation copies stay loops.
